author: reek
body: Explorer webapp server. Reads a multi-table .db off the attached disk (ExplorerStore format, raw sectors via block-read-sector) and serves any table by name as JSON over framed TCP via the WebServer std-include. A request /api/<name> (or /api/d/<name>) returns that table's rows as a JSON array of field-arrays: [["Forest","dense ..."], ...]. No serial.

author: reek
body: A user's saved creations (generated settings/characters/items) persist on disk as one ExplorerStore page in a fixed region (sectors cr-start..). Each row is [owner-id, kind, name, data]; owner-id is the account id as text so a plain text compare selects "mine". Stateless per request: save re-reads the region, appends, and rewrites it; the route holds no in-memory content.
